honesty.envelope: a space must fit the room of its strand in every serving hall, read from web/interiors.py plan_for exactly as web/build_3d.py lays it out (3 m per grid unit); the room is a functional programme, not a survey of a building
honesty.footprints: an item with no size_m in its registry is recorded as footprint unknown and its overlap is not checked; nothing is assumed
honesty.not_stated: no duration, price, accreditation or venue
honesty.ppe: never typed: strand base PPE plus the PPE of every hazard the surfaces rules say the chosen floor and wall stand for in that strand's room; a hazard prop is admitted only when the finishes already derive a hazard it is keyed to
honesty.status: declared, not yet walkable: an AUTHORED proposal composed from this bundle's own assets; nothing here is built into the 3D world, no dimension is a measurement of a real venue, and no duration, price or accreditation is stated
